Debris field, offshore Columbia River entrance

2012-06-27
On June 26 USCG Sector Columbia River contacted NOAA SSC regarding a debris field consisting of small styrofoam pieces, spherical floats, and othe debris located roughly 20 miles offshore the Columbia River entrance. NOAA provided information on if the debris field would hit shore soon or not, and where. In the short term (i.e. next couple of days), the debris field is not expected to hit shore because of the strong influence of the Columbia River output.
